commands:
set -euo pipefail
printf '%s\n' '=== continuation state ==='
git status --short
test -f frontend/src/components/map/trackpadZoom.ts
test -f frontend/src/components/map/MapTrackpadZoom.tsx
test -f frontend/e2e/visual/map-trackpad-zoom.spec.ts
printf '%s\n' '=== previous e2e backend log ==='
tail -n 60 .dev/e2e/backend.log 2>/dev/null || true
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-e2e-XXXXXX)
cleanup() { rm -rf "$VENV"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- e2e/visual/map-trackpad-zoom.spec.ts --project=chromium
cd ..
git diff --check
git add frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx frontend/src/components/map/MapTrackpadZoom.tsx frontend/src/components/map/trackpadZoom.ts frontend/src/components/map/trackpadZoom.test.ts frontend/e2e/visual/map-trackpad-zoom.spec.ts
git commit -m 'Fix Mac trackpad map zoom sensitivity'
git push origin HEAD:work/photomap-straighten-20260912
printf 'published_sha=' && git rev-parse HEAD
